gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all components associated with my projects to ensure that I have a clear understanding of the different parts of the project.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of components with their details, including names, descriptions, and associated project IDs.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to create a new component for my project so that I can organize my code better.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the component's name, description, and project ID, and return the created component's details.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to delete a component that is no longer needed to keep the project clean and organized.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the component and return a success message.

gold.user: As a QA engineer, I want to retrieve the details of a specific component to understand its functionality and test it effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return the component's details, including its name, description, and associated project ID.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to update the details of a component to reflect changes in project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with updated component details and return the updated component's information.
